description: Source-reviewed layer geometry setting mutants for first-layer height, shell-thickness propagation, and surface-density roles.

mutants.description: Ignore the configured initial layer print height and always use the object layer height.

Remove bottom shell thickness from vertical shell propagation while retaining the configured shell-layer count.
Force top external-solid fill to 100 percent and mask the configured top surface density.
